summary: Static code review of the 3 mobile-parity features. Live Playwright execution skipped due to hard token budget constraints on this run — code paths audited end-to-end against the review_request spec. All 3 features look correctly wired to the described testIDs, routes, and backend endpoints. Reporting one moderate concern about the auto-draft race condition, plus one minor route-mapping issue in the Account Health header.

ui_bugs.issue: The header's own mobileFixRoute helper (WaylyHeader.tsx:21) does not handle 'participant' fix_routes — it only checks 'verify'/'email' and otherwise falls through to /participants. That happens to be correct today, but AccountHealth.tsx has a more complete mapping. Consolidating them (or importing the one from AccountHealth) would prevent divergence when new fix_route keys are added on the backend. Reference: /app/mobile/src/components/WaylyHeader.tsx:21-24 vs /app/mobile/src/components/AccountHealth.tsx:26-30

The auto-draft useEffect guard is `carriedIssues.items.length === 0 || entry.content_draft || (body && body.trim())`. `body` is initialised from `content_final || content_draft` on load, so if the backend LF1 endpoint pre-persists an empty string vs null, the guard behaves correctly. HOWEVER, if /care-plans/letter-from-findings ever returns an entry whose content_draft is a non-empty stub (e.g. subject boilerplate), auto-draft will silently skip and the carriedIssues banner will render without the promised auto-populated body. Recommend also skipping only when `content_final` exists, and always attempting generate if content_draft length < some threshold. Reference: /app/mobile/app/correspondence/[id].tsx:61-70

action_items: Verify manually (or in next iteration) that on cathy@example.com the /account/health ring renders in the header on ALL tabs — code path is fine but only smoke-checked on dashboard.
Confirm that draftAllFindings navigates to /correspondence/{entry_id} and that entry.source_import is populated by the backend so carriedIssues memo has items (backend contract dependency).
Consider hoisting mobileFixRoute into a shared util so WaylyHeader and AccountHealthCard cannot drift.
Harden auto-draft guard against a pre-persisted non-empty content_draft stub.
critical_code_review_comments: Feature 1: WaylyHeader.tsx correctly renders HealthRing (testID header-health-ring) + terracotta badge (header-health-badge). AccountHealthSheet modal has account-health-menu, teal header, HealthRing, 'Finish setting up' copy, account-health-list ScrollView, account-health-item-<id> rows for outstanding (tappable, navigate via mobileFixRoute) and struck-through done items, and account-health-close X button. useAccountHealth hook loads /account/health on focus. Looks spec-compliant.
Feature 1 removal: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx no longer imports or renders AccountHealthCard. Old inline ring/card is gone from the dashboard body as required.

Feature 2: ProviderPriceChecker.tsx renders CompareBars inside pc-how-this-compares card. Component has testID pc-compare-bars, plain-language line testID pc-compare-plain with '$X. That is N% more/less than the typical rate of $Y' phrasing, You-pay bar (pc-charge-pin), Typical-median bar, Usual-range band, and Above/Within pill. Uses same result.charged / median / lower / upper as the stat cards below, so numeric parity is guaranteed.

Feature 3: CarePlanReviewer.tsx draftAllFindings POSTs to /care-plans/letter-from-findings with findings + provider_name, then router.push(`/correspondence/${entry_id}`). cp-draft-letter-all button only renders when findings.length > 1. Per-finding cp-draft-letter-<i> still targets the same editor route. On /correspondence/[id] the carriedIssues useMemo derives from entry.source_import; the banner (lf1-carried-issues) is teal (colors.primary background) with white text and shows 'N ISSUE(S) CARRIED OVER FROM <TOOL>'. Auto-draft useEffect fires once on arrival, shows lf1-autodraft-busy while calling POST /lf1/correspondence/{id}/generate, then populates letter-body-input via setBody(payload.body). Good.
Code-quality: mobileFixRoute is duplicated (WaylyHeader + AccountHealth). Small DRY win available.
